description: Shows how many Higgsfield credits you have, when they reset, and how many will expire unused at your current pace. A burn forecast charts this cycle's balance and projects it to the reset date, so you see whether you run out early or leave credits behind. A per-model table counts generations, refunded failures, credits, and cost per generation, tagged image, video, audio, or text. A daily chart stacks spend by model or media type for this cycle, 7, 30, or 90 days. Requires the Higgsfield CLI and a Higgsfield account; sign-in uses Higgsfield's own browser login.
